latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

bill.title: Dr. William W. Sullivan TRIO Upward Bound Student Stipend Support Act

aiDescription.summary: This bill amends HEA section 402C(f) to raise FY2027 Upward Bound stipends from $60 to $180, $300 to $900, and $40 to $120, and sets veteran project stipends up to $300. Future maximums will be indexed to the CPI and rounded to the nearest $10 for projects under section 402C.

impact.summary: The bill raises 2027 monthly stipend caps for Upward Bound (TRIO) participants—tripling limits—and allows veterans in subsection (d)(6) projects up to $300. Beginning 2028 the Secretary of Education must annually raise caps by estimated CPI, rounded to $10, affecting Upward Bound grantees (colleges, districts, nonprofits).
